beginner.stem: Which of these is a listed use of Platinum?

beginner.stem: Which history line belongs to Platinum?
options: On 9 November 1994, GSI fused nickel-62 with lead-208 and observed element 110.
Platinum was worked in South America before European chemists had a name for it.
Axel Fredrik Cronstedt isolated a metal from the ore Kupfernickel, devil’s copper, in 1751, and named it nickel.

beginner.explanation: Platinum was worked in South America before European chemists had a name for it.

beginner.explanation: Grains of a white metal turned up in the gold sands of the Chocó, in New Granada.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Platinum in this catalog?

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Platinum in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: A Spanish scientist described the awkward white metal, and another traveler brought pieces to Europe, where the samples could finally be studied.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Platinum in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: Two English chemists turned the difficult white metal into a trade, and the sludge from purifying it still hid further discoveries.
